title: Bag of Bricks- Aqua Blue 07
descriptionHtml:
Aqua Blue — colour 07

Fresh turquoise with a tropical feel. Aqua Blue is the shortcut to shallow water, pool scenes and coastal light — anywhere you want blue to feel warm rather than cold.

Works well with: Shiny Blue 05, Stone Blue 18, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Aqua Blue bricks (colour 07) for Memobrick mosaics. A fresh turquoise for tropical water, pool scenes and bright coastal artwork.
